scope: All75 canonical pages and corresponding pinned iddqd master sections where present. Compare rune-index boundary positions, not just rune strings.
rules: Explicit punctuation separates lexical segments; line slashes and whitespace do not. Page joins introduce no inferred word boundary. Non-rune content remains recorded and separates surrounding rune segments. Apostrophes split lexical segments to match the unchanged external corpus tokenizer; this is not a claim that an apostrophe is a printed word separator.
source_policy: Preserve exact raw text, character offsets and explicit rune-alias records. No changed canonical data. Unknown unlisted punctuation is an error.
gate: A page with competing rune or internal boundary positions is flagged, not silently merged. Only source-agreeing layouts eligible for an initial boundary-scored attack.
null_model: Not applicable: deterministic source audit, no significance or decryption claim.
